$description.en_us: Data-driven Forging Method definition from MiXianTu.
$description.zh_cn: 由觅仙途数据包加载的单次锻打操作定义。

$description.en_us: How far the meter moves on a successful strike. Positive moves right, negative moves left, and zero is rejected at load time.
$description.zh_cn: 一次成功锻打让数值条移动的格数。正数向右、负数向左，写 0 会在数据包加载期被拒绝。

$description.en_us: One resource cost paid on each strike.
$description.zh_cn: 每次锻打支付的一项资源消耗。

$description.en_us: Resources paid on every successful strike. Omit it for a free method.
$description.zh_cn: 每次成功锻打支付的全部资源消耗。省略即为不消耗。

$description.en_us: Condition the striker has to meet before this method may be used. Omit it to always allow.
$description.zh_cn: 使用该方式前必须满足的实体条件。省略即始终可用。

$description.en_us: Item id drawn in the method selector and used as this method's name. Omit it and the button shows the method id.
$description.zh_cn: 方法选择格里绘制的物品 ID，同时也作为该方式的名字。省略时按钮显示方式 ID。

$description.en_us: Ticks before the same player may strike the same table again, 0 to 72000. Enforced by the server's strike rate limiter.
$description.zh_cn: 同一玩家对同一锻造台的连续锻打间隔，单位 tick，范围 0..72000，由服务端限流执行。

$description.en_us: Sound played at the table when this method is struck. Heard by every player in range, on the Blocks channel. Use minecraft:intentionally_empty for a silent method.
$description.zh_cn: 使用该方式锻打成功时在锻造台播放的音效，附近所有玩家都能听到，走 blocks 音量通道。写 minecraft:intentionally_empty 即为静音。
